exposure: births before implementation of revised CTG classification (June 1, 2014 - May 31, 2016)
births after implementation of revised CTG classification (June 1, 2018 - May 31, 2020)
outcome: moderate to severe neonatal hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE 2-3)
cohort: Births in Sweden from June 1, 2014 to May 31, 2016 (cohort I, n = 160,210) and June 1, 2018 to May 31, 2020 (cohort II, n = 166,558), data collected from the Swedish Pregnancy and Neonatal Registers
finding: While not statistically significant, a small increase in the incidence of moderate to severe neonatal hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE 2-3) after implementation of the revised CTG classification cannot be excluded.
mod_finding: Operative deliveries were fewer in the cohort exposed to the revised CTG classification.
